attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation – Physician Assistant licensing

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 CME as determined by NCCPA (sponsors AAFP, AAPA, AMA/ACCME, AOA or Department-approved schools/agencies/associations; also AAPA-preapproved certification programs, PI-CME, self-assessment); Category 2 for the remaining 25 hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal of an Illinois license.
rules.alternatives: Waiver for good cause (armed forces service, incapacitating illness, physical inability to access programs) on affidavit filed before the renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Certify compliance on the renewal application; proof (certificates) only in a random audit. Out-of-state programs from non-approved sponsors need prior approval ($25).

topics.who: All individual licensees; counts toward CE
Health care professionals with CE requirements, from the first renewal requiring CE
Renewals on/after Jan 1, 2025: before the first renewal requiring CE, then once every six years (20 ILCS 2105/2105-365)
Renewals on/after Jan 1, 2025: before the first renewal requiring CE, then once every six years (20 ILCS 2105/2105-370)
PAs who work with children: mandated reporter training at least every six years; others attest at each renewal (325 ILCS 5/4)

rules.notes: Licenses expire March 1 of even-numbered years; 50 hours in the 24 months before expiration. Renewal fee $40 per year. Mandated topic hours count toward the 50.
